title: Rounded box geometry with face groups
purpose: Build a three.js box whose edges and corners are rounded to one radius, with smooth bevel normals, per-face UVs and BoxGeometry's six material groups, from a typed-array generator that also runs in Node. Use it for devices, furniture, buttons, UI panels and soft props.

engine.name: webgl2_browser
engine.notes: roundedBoxData needs no three.js; createRoundedBoxGeometry takes three.js as THREE (any release with BufferGeometry groups); only 0.186.1 was run.

exports.name: roundedBoxData
exports.summary: The box as typed arrays: Float32Array positions, normals and uvs, Uint16Array or Uint32Array indices (counter-clockwise from outside) and six groups in BoxGeometry face order.

exports.name: createRoundedBoxGeometry
exports.summary: The same data in a BufferGeometry with an index, six groups and computed bounds.

exports.name: roundedBoxVolume
exports.summary: Exact volume of the smooth rounded box.

options.name: radius
options.meaning: Rounding radius; 0 gives a sharp box, half the size a sphere along that axis.

options.name: bevelSegments
options.meaning: Divisions of each half bevel (an eighth of a turn), spaced by equal angles.

options.name: flatSegments
options.meaning: Divisions across each flat face strip.

outputs.vertices_per_face: (2 * bevelSegments + flatSegments + 1) squared for a cube with a flat middle
outputs.index_type: Uint16Array up to 65535 vertices, else Uint32Array

limits: One radius for every edge: no per-edge radii, chamfers or bevel profiles. Each face is its own grid, so vertices are repeated along the twelve face seams (positions and normals match there; UVs do not, as in BoxGeometry). The bevel samples are equally spaced in angle along edges and only approximately so at corners, so corner quads are uneven. The mesh volume is slightly under the smooth volume roundedBoxVolume gives. Only 0.186.1 was run, in headless Chrome on SwiftShader WebGL 2.
technique_references: Minkowski sum of a box and a ball: nearest inner-box point plus radius times the unit offset
Angle-uniform bevel sampling with t = -(h - r) - r tan(phi)
Closed-form volume of a rounded box (box, slabs, quarter cylinders, ball)
